intelligence.human_view: The action row is the smallest thing on a feed post and the most-touched — it is where a citizen says what a post meant to them, and where the post's standing is counted. A flat LOVE / LIKE row with plain numbers undersells the thing it measures. Ten stars is the language of the whole system — "we talk about 10 stars all the time" — so a five-star cap would make the feed speak a smaller language than the house speaks. Circles with a flow around them, stars that light up when you click: that is the orbit and the light-up he has already ruled for the bottom bar and the icons, brought to the feed. And the question underneath — one choice point or two standing buttons — is the push-button-simple question: one elegant place to say what you feel, or two buttons side by side. The comment box matters the same way: the "why" behind the stars is the intelligence, and a beautiful box is what invites it.
intelligence.simple_view: When you love a post, you should be able to show it in the prettiest way! Big beautiful buttons, shiny stars that light up when you tap them — and not just five stars, TEN stars, because ten is our number! And a lovely little box where you can write why you loved it.
intelligence.grandma_view: When you love a post, dear, you should be able to show it in the prettiest way! Big beautiful buttons, shiny stars that light up when you tap them — and not just five stars, TEN stars, because ten is our number! And a lovely little box where you can write why you loved it.
intelligence.naya_view: THE FEED POST TEMPLATE: BEAUTIFUL LOVE AND LIKE BUTTONS, DASHBOARD-LIKE NUMBERS, A STAR RATING THAT LIGHTS UP ON CLICK WITH A FLOW AROUND THE CIRCLES — UP TO 10 STARS, BECAUSE WE TALK ABOUT 10 STARS ALL THE TIME — AND A BEAUTIFUL COMMENT BOX FOR THE WHY. ONE CHOICE POINT OR TWO STANDING BUTTONS — THE CAPTAIN DECIDES WHAT IS MOST ELEGANT, AND SHAWN CONFIRMS. NOTHING IS DECIDED UNTIL THEN.
